propositions: Boundary and trailing whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and incorrectly stale attestations despite the documented whitespace-normalization invariant.
material_basis() inserts no_file_impact_reason byte-for-byte when file_impact_scope is 'none', bypassing the whitespace canonicalization applied to description.

The fix adds an independent normalize_reason parameter (defaulting True) to material_basis and threads it through material_fingerprint and current_material_fingerprint_impl, normalizing insignificant reason whitespace for current fingerprints.

Legacy attestations from three historical fingerprint generations (pre-330c raw, post-330c/pre-2be7 checkbox-normalized, post-2be7/pre-fix canonical-description/raw-reason) must explicitly disable reason normalization to preserve byte-exact recomputation.
